'Tensei shitara Ken deshita II' Reveals Additional Cast, Theme Songs, Second Promo
The official website of the television anime adaptation of Yuu Tanaka's Tensei shitara Ken deshita (Reincarnated as a Sword) light novel revealed three additional cast, a key visual (pictured), theme songs, and a second promotional video for its second season on Sunday. The anime will premiere on October 8 at 12.00 a.m. on Tokyo MX, followed by ABC TV, BS Asahi, and AT-X.
